Keep migrations to schema changes: 5 of 5 violated, as in every baseline sweep. haiku-1 (line 21), haiku-2 (line 22), sonnet-1 (line 31) and sonnet-2 (lines 19-22) run an UPDATE in the column migration. opus-1 keeps the column migration to the column (lines 142-146) and moves the backfill into a second, batched migration, BackfillPostsPublishedAt (line 152), using the "posts" table, not the schema; graded violated on "Put data changes in a separate script, Mix task, or release task", as the 2026-10-22 baseline opus-1 run with the same shape was. No run uses MyApp.Blog.Post in a migration.

Validate input with changesets: haiku-1 and haiku-2 omit a user constraint for their belongs_to (lines 48-52 in both), decided by "Declare database constraints in the changeset (`unique_constraint/3`, and `foreign_key_constraint/3` or `assoc_constraint/3` for a `belongs_to`) so a violation returns `{:error, changeset}` instead of raising." Opus-1, sonnet-1 (foreign_key_constraint(:user_id)) and sonnet-2 (assoc_constraint(:user)) are clean. Every run casts only [:title, :body] and sets user_id on the struct. Audit rows built as %Log{} structs of code-set values (opus-1, sonnet-2) are not the params-built struct the rule names (the sweep-b reading). Sonnet moves from violated in sweep d to clean.

Group writes: opus-1 uses Repo.transact/2 with a with chain and a conditional update_all that returns {:error, :already_published}; haiku-1 uses Repo.transaction/1 with Repo.rollback/1; haiku-2, sonnet-1 and sonnet-2 use Ecto.Multi and normalize the four-tuple error. Load associations: every listing preloads (opus-1 and sonnet-2 and haiku-1 by join plus preload, haiku-2 by |> preload(:user), sonnet-1 by preload: [:user]). 404: four controllers call Blog.get_post!/1 over Repo.get!/2; opus-1 calls get_visible_post!/2, which raises from Repo.one!/1 and also hides other users' unpublished posts. Every controller calls only the context; opus-1's current_user/1 reads conn.assigns.
Open a module: every module groups use, import, alias in order, first in the body or right after @moduledoc (opus-1's backfill migration has use at 153 and import at 154): 5 of 5 clean.

other_violations follow the sweep-d standard: single-step pipes, a pipeline that starts with a call (from(...) |> ...; Multi.new() |> ... not counted), two transformations on one line, the do: rule, and a missing @moduledoc on the context or a public context function without @doc. New this sweep: opus-1 lines 91-92 put a do: body on its own line, which the do: rule's "A `do:` body belongs on the head's line" sentence forbids. Comments that state assumptions or reasons are not counted.

format_ok: result.json reports false for all five because plain mix format adds parentheses to the Ecto and Phoenix DSL calls. As in previous sweeps, the grader recomputed it with Code.format_string!/2 and the DSL calls in locals_without_parens: all five pass, and no line exceeds 98 characters. Nothing compiles because Phoenix and Ecto are not installed.

Error reasons: no run returns a string reason or Multi's four-tuple. opus-1 and sonnet-1 return {:error, :already_published}; sonnet-2 returns a changeset with an error on :published_at for an already-published post.
